description: This file defines data models for asset copy lineage in a .NET backend project, including DTOs for persistence and request models for create and query operations related to asset copy lineage records.

classes.name: CreateAssetCopyLineageRequest
classes.description: Represents the payload for creating a new asset copy lineage record, including metadata such as timestamps, user info, and result status.

classes.name: QueryAssetCopyLineageRequest
classes.description: Contains filter parameters for querying asset copy lineage records based on operation ID, source, and target asset IDs, and result limit.

methods.name: AssetCopyLineageDto
methods.description: A record type representing the persisted asset copy lineage data, mapped to the database table 'asset_copy_lineage'.
